title: perf(canary): add automated latency/throughput regression detector and rollout guards
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds an automated regression detector for latency and throughput to the perf canary pipeline; introduces rollout guard policies (hysteresis, KV-aware thresholds); new dashboards and alerting; rollout gated behind feature flag and conservative defaults.
description: Motivation: intermittent latency and throughput regressions in the serving runtime have caused noisy rollouts and production incidents. This PR implements an automated detector that ingests perf canary metrics and raises deterministic regression signals, plus a set of rollout guards (hysteresis, KV-cache-aware thresholds, and sensitivity profiles) to prevent unsafe traffic shifts. Changes: 1) detector pipeline that computes rolling-window latency and tps deltas against baseline percentiles and applies adaptive thresholds; 2) rollout_guards module implementing hysteresis and KV-aware suppression when cache-hit ratios change; 3) configuration schema for sensitivity profiles per model/route; 4) perf canary CI job and synthetic load tests; 5) dashboards and alerting rules; 6) documentation and an ops runbook. Testing: unit tests for detector math, integration tests using synthetic canary harness comparing against stored baselines, smoke runs on staging GPU pools. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on main, enable in staging for 48h with conservative thresholds, expand to canary traffic cohorts if no regressions, enable automatic halt on detector=true with manual override. Checklist: [x] detector implementation complete [x] unit tests added [x] integration harness added [x] dashboards updated [x] docs updated [x] Linear tasks linked ENG-7124, ENG-7190. Impact: default settings are conservative and non-breaking; ops can tune sensitivity per workload.
commits: feat(canary): add detector logic, rolling-window baselining, and adaptive thresholds
feat(rollout): implement hysteresis and KV-cache-aware guard policies
chore(ci): add perf-canary synthetic-load workflow and integration harness
test(canary): add unit and integration tests for detector and guards
docs(perf): update perf-canary troubleshooting and runbook
review_threads: Carlos: Can you justify the chosen 5-minute rolling window? Author: We picked 5m as a tradeoff between sensitivity and noise; added config to tune per workload.
Rina: Lint flagged long function in rollout_guards.py; please split for readability. Author: Split into two helpers and added docstrings.
Evan: How does detector behave with KV-cache warmup? Author: We included KV-awareness: if cache-hit ratio drops >10% within window, thresholds scale by hysteresis factor; added tests and comments.
Carlos: CI integration failed on first run due to flaky kube scheduling; reran and all checks passed. Approvals: Carlos + Rina approved after fixes.
merge_outcome_summary: Merged after approvals and CI green; feature gated behind perf_canary_autodetect FF and defaulted to conservative sensitivity; rollout guard active in staging; ops notified.
observability_notes: New metrics: canary.detector.regression_signal, canary.rollout_guard.halt_count, canary.detector.latency_delta_pct; dashboards updated; alerting on regression_signal > 0 for >2 consecutive windows.
notes_for_release: No API changes; opt-in via feature flag. Recommended owners: SRE and Serving Runtime teams for tuning.
